planets.name: HD 23472 e
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 23472 with a 7.91-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: HD 23472 e was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 5 planets known around HD 23472. Its orbit and size follow Barros et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
